summary: Encrypted clipboard image bytes, sampled touch boundaries, elastic layer motion

changes.title: Encrypted clipboard images
changes.detail: Local cached image bytes use authenticated AES-GCM in a separate sealed file behind the original URI, with bounded grant-only read leases and verified legacy migration. Thumbnails do not enter Coil caches.

changes.title: Recognition boundaries
changes.detail: Compare the baseline detector with the adaptive chooser on a matching live keyboard layout, using sampled positions rather than stored raw taps.

changes.title: Elastic symbol and popup motion
changes.detail: ABC/123 and long-press popup content settle using a short canvas-only effect that leaves actual touch geometry and glass unchanged.
